item.text: {"case_id":"SHC068","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C01","C18","C12"],"selected_candidate_label":"C01","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C01 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template for the child. Both proclamations revise a national monument through the same distinctive operative sequence: exclude specifically described lands; temporarily withhold the excluded lands from application, location, settlement, entry, or appropriation until an authorized Interior officer orders otherwise; subject to valid existing rights, add and reserve described lands as part of the monument and apply the monument's laws, rules, and regulations; and give the same express warning against damaging monument features or locating or settling on monument lands. C18 is also a strong parallel, while C12 contains the exclusion-and-temporary-withdrawal machinery but not the full monument exclusion/addition sequence.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The
